Title: VITAMIN C GLOW SERUM
Body (HTML):
A lightweight brightening serum with 10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Ferulic Acid and Licorice Root extract.

Fades dark spots & dullness. Suitable for normal, oily and combination skin. Fragrance free. Vegan.
How to use: Apply 3-4 drops on clean face every morning before moisturiser. Always follow with sunscreen.
Caution: Patch test first. May tingle slightly. Avoid using with retinol at the same time.

Title: Niacinamide 10% Clarifying Serum
Body (HTML):
Clarifying serum with 10% Niacinamide + 1% Zinc PCA. Controls oil, minimises pores, reduces acne marks.
Best for oily & acne-prone skin. Non-comedogenic, fragrance-free, vegan
How to use: 2-3 drops AM and/or PM after cleansing.

Title: HYALURONIC HYDRA SERUM
Body (HTML): Deep hydration with multi-weight Hyaluronic Acid and Panthenol (Vit B5). Plumps fine lines. For ALL skin types incl. sensitive skin. Vegan | Fragrance Free
How to use: Apply on damp skin, morning and night.

Title: Gentle Retinol Night Serum
Body (HTML): Beginner-friendly 0.3% encapsulated Retinol with Bakuchiol & Squalane. Targets fine lines, uneven texture. For normal, dry & combination skin. Not for sensitive skin.
How to use: Use at NIGHT only, 2-3 times a week to start. Pea-sized amount.
Caution: Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use sunscreen daily. Do not mix with Vitamin C or AHAs.

Title: MINERAL SUNSCREEN SPF 50
Body (HTML):
100% mineral (Zinc Oxide) broad-spectrum SPF 50 PA++++. No white cast. Reef safe. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin.

Fragrance free.
How to use: Apply generously as the last step of AM routine. Reapply every 2-3 hours outdoors.

Title: Tinted Sun Gel SPF 50
Body (HTML): Tinted gel sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ with Niacinamide and Iron Oxides - evens tone & protects from blue light. Best for oily and combination skin. Contains fragrance.
How to use: Apply two-finger amount before stepping out.

Title: Ceramide Barrier Moisturiser
Body (HTML): Rich moisturiser with 3 Ceramides, Cholesterol & Oat extract to repair the skin barrier. For dry, very dry & sensitive skin. Fragrance-free. Dermatologically tested.
How to use: Massage onto face and neck AM & PM.

Title: Oil-Free Gel Moisturiser
Body (HTML): Oil free water-gel with Green Tea, Hyaluronic acid. Non-greasy, non comedogenic. Ideal for OILY & acne-prone skin.
How to use: Use morning and night after serum.

Title: Overnight Repair Night Cream
Body (HTML): Night cream with Peptides, Shea Butter, Ceramides. Repairs while you sleep. Normal to dry skin.

Title: Turmeric Foaming Face Wash
Body (HTML): Gentle foaming cleanser with Turmeric, Tea Tree Oil & Salicylic Acid 0.5%. Removes oil and dirt without stripping. For oily, combination and acne-prone skin. SLS-free.
How to use: Lather with water, massage 30 sec, rinse. Twice daily.

Title: GREEN TEA CLEANSING OIL
Body (HTML): Melts makeup & sunscreen. Green Tea, Jojoba & Sunflower oils. Emulsifies with water. Suitable for all skin types.
How to use: Massage onto DRY face, add water to emulsify, rinse. Follow with face wash.

Title: Matte Lip Tint - Rose
Body (HTML): Transfer-proof matte lip & cheek tint, shade ROSE (cool pink). With Vitamin E. Lasts 8 hrs. Vegan, cruelty free.
How to use: Swipe on lips; blend on cheeks with fingertip.

Title: Matte Lip Tint - Nude
Body (HTML): Transfer-proof matte lip & cheek tint, shade NUDE (warm beige-brown, suits medium to deep skin tones). With Vitamin E. Vegan.
How to use: Swipe on lips; blend on cheeks.

Title: Matte Lip Tint - Berry
Body (HTML): Matte lip & cheek tint, shade BERRY (deep plum). Vitamin E. Long wear. Vegan, cruelty-free.

Title: Beetroot Lip Balm
Body (HTML): Tinted lip balm with Beetroot extract, Shea Butter and Kokum Butter. Heals dry, chapped lips. Natural pink tint.
How to use: Apply as often as needed.

Title: Onion & Bhringraj Hair Oil
Body (HTML): Ayurvedic hair oil with Red Onion, Bhringraj, Amla & Coconut oil. Reduces hair fall and strengthens roots. For all hair types.
How to use: Massage into scalp, leave 1 hr or overnight, wash off with shampoo. 2-3 times a week.

Title: RICE WATER SHAMPOO
Body (HTML): Sulphate-free shampoo with fermented Rice Water and Keratin protein. For dull, frizzy and damaged hair. Colour safe.
How to use: Lather on wet hair, rinse.

Title: CAFFEINE UNDER-EYE CREAM
Body (HTML): Under eye cream with 5% Caffeine, Peptides and Vitamin K. Reduces puffiness and dark circles. Suitable for all skin types. Fragrance free.
How to use: Gently dab a rice-grain amount around eyes AM & PM.

Title: GLOW STARTER KIT
Body (HTML): Kit with Vitamin C Glow Serum 30ml + Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 50g + Turmeric Foaming Face Wash 100ml. Complete morning routine for dull skin. Save 15%.
How to use: Cleanse > Serum > Sunscreen every morning.

Title: KAOLIN CLAY MASK
Body (HTML): Detox mask with Kaolin & Bentonite clay, Niacinamide. Unclogs pores, controls excess oil. For oily and combination skin.
How to use: Apply thin layer, leave 10 min, rinse. 1-2 times a week.
Caution: Do not use on broken skin.
